title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1969-06-21

ai_review.summary: Excellent 1969 soundboard capture of a laid‑back yet powerful show, highlighted by Dire Wolf, The Eleven and Lovelight with crystal‑clear audio.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers an unexpectedly pristine sound for a 1969 board tape, letting listeners hear the band’s shift from psychedelia to country‑rock in vivid detail. Standout moments include Jerry’s sweet pedal‑steel on “Dire Wolf,” the fiery “Eleven” jam and the beautiful acoustic/“Lovelight” segment, all wrapped in an overall relaxed but powerful performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Eight detailed reviews are overwhelmingly positive (average 4.4★) and praise both the musical set and the excellent soundboard quality, leading to a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note the sound quality is exceptional for a ’69 show—crisp, clear, and well‑balanced with no reported dropouts or major issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A relaxed yet energetic set that marks the band’s transition from psychedelic jams to a more folk‑country vibe, with smooth segues and memorable acoustic moments.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for sweet pedal‑steel on “Dire Wolf” and his emerging Fender Strat tone, described as ‘sweet’ and a key part of the show’s appeal.
